🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 divides by 1000 instead of 100, so every coupon discount is one tenth of the contracted value and checkoutTotal (which calls couponCents) overcharges customers; change the divisor to 100
🔵 [split-n-zero] CUT/FOLLOW-UP src/split.js:4 divides by n with no guard for n=0; the spec does not define behavior for n=0, so this is optional hardening excluded from this version

🟠 [coupon-div-by-1000] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:5 computes Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000) but the contract specifies Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100); the discount is 10x too small (couponCents(10000, 10) returns 100 instead of 1000), and the error propagates through src/checkout.js:7 so every couponed checkout total is overstated; smallest fix is dividing by 100 instead of 1000.
🔵 [clamp-nan-guard] CUT/FOLLOW-UP src/clamp.js:4 non-numeric input would clamp to NaN, but the spec only defines truncation and clamping of numeric quantities, so defensive input guards are optional hardening excluded from this version.

🟠 [bulk-threshold] MUST-FIX src/bulk.js:4 — the condition `qty > 10` excludes qty=10 from the discount, but the spec requires the 10% discount when qty is 10 or more; change to `qty >= 10`
🟠 [coupon-divisor] MUST-FIX src/coupon.js:4 — the expression divides by 1000 instead of 100 (`Math.round((subtotal * p) / 1000)`), producing a discount one-tenth of the spec's `Math.round(subtotal * pct / 100)`; change divisor to 100
